input: Source a refurbished espresso machine under budget

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The budget ceiling is the core constraint of the task — it directly filters which machines and sellers are even worth considering.
Espresso machines vary enormously by type (manual, semi-automatic, fully automatic, pod-based) — the specific type determines the entire search space.
Whether this is for home personal use or a commercial/office setting changes the required capacity, durability, and appropriate models entirely.
Brand or model preferences — or brands to avoid — can immediately narrow or redirect sourcing efforts.
Whether the user wants to buy online, locally, or is open to both affects which sourcing channels to prioritise.
The acceptable condition and refurbishment standard (e.g. seller-certified, manufacturer-refurbished, cosmetic wear OK) defines what counts as a valid find.
The urgency or target date for having the machine in hand affects whether to wait for the right deal or act quickly on available stock.

gold.taskTitle: Source a refurbished espresso machine under budget
gold.taskDescription: Find and purchase a refurbished espresso machine that fits within a set budget.

questions.title: What is your maximum budget for this machine?
questions.description: Establish the hard spending ceiling so every sourcing option can be filtered against it immediately.

questions.title: What type of espresso machine are you looking for?
questions.description: Identify whether the user wants a manual lever, semi-automatic, fully automatic, or pod-based machine to define the product category.

questions.title: Is this for home use or a commercial setting?
questions.description: Determine the intended environment and usage volume, which shapes the required spec and suitable models.

questions.title: Do you have preferred brands or models in mind?
questions.description: Capture any brand loyalty, past experience, or specific models the user is targeting — or wants to avoid.

questions.title: Do you prefer buying online, locally, or either?
questions.description: Understand the preferred sourcing channel to focus on marketplaces, local dealers, or a combination of both.

questions.title: What refurbishment standard is acceptable to you?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user requires manufacturer-certified refurbishment, will accept seller-refurbished, or is comfortable with cosmetic wear as long as it functions fully.

questions.title: When do you need the machine by?
questions.description: Establish the urgency or target delivery date to decide whether to wait for the ideal deal or prioritise speed of acquisition.
